    About Aster

    Aster is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures and spot trading, mainly on BNB Chain. ASTER is its governance and utility token.

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (ASTER-USD), Binance (ASTER/USDT) and Kraken (ASTER/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
